newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Parent's stake in COSCO Pacific diluted.
newsitem.headline: Parent's stake in COSCO Pacific diluted.

text.p: COSCO (Hong Kong) Group Ltd's stake in its listed unit COSCO Pacific Ltd will be diluted to 56.6 percent from 65.5 percent following a share placement, said joint lead manager Barclays de Zoete Wedd (Asia) Ltd.
COSCO Pacific is placing 250 million shares, representing about 15 percent of the company's existing share capital, at HK$6.20 each.
"The proceeds will be used to finance container purchases as well as to increase working capital," an official at Barclays said on Monday.
COSCO (Hong Kong), the local arm of China's state-owned China Ocean Shipping (Group) Co, since May 6 raised its stake in COSCO Pacific from 64.17 percent.
Goldman Sach is also joint lead manager of the placement.
